description.description of test case: Quasi-static passive inflation of a fixed-length thick-walled cylinder (ChamberCylinder) 2x as long as passive_helical (L = 114.21 mm, 8.2 wall thicknesses) with one helical fiber family with a transmurally varying helix angle from +60 deg at the endocardium to 0 deg at the epicardium (a varying angle and a large net twist): cavity pressure ramped from 0 to 120 mmHg (15998.69 Pa) over 1200 s in 24 steps of 50 s (5 mmHg), then held. Holzapfel-Ogden law (svMultiPhysics HolzapfelOgden) reduced to the passive_isotropic wall plus one fiber family: a = 100 kPa, b = 0 (neo-Hookean, mu = a), a_f = 100 kPa, b_f = 1, k = 0 (no tension-compression switch); sheet and fiber-sheet terms off (a_s = a_fs = 0; svMultiPhysics divides by b_s, b_fs, set to 1); ST91 bulk modulus 100 a = 10 MPa. SI units. Source of the matching 3D svMultiPhysics case (cylinder_3d.py): full cylinder and full length (helical fibers have no mirror symmetry), both ends u_z = 0, twist and radial expansion free.
